_comment: Talent builds for swarm bots, one per class and role. 'columns' is the order in which a bot fills the talent tree's paths (0, 1, 2 = left, middle, right column of the class tab); 'talents' optionally pins talent ids to take first. The bot resolves this against the live talent data, skipping placeholders and anything whose tier or prerequisites are not met yet, so a changed tree does not break the build. Roles: tank, healer, dps.
